item.title: Flights to resume at NYC-area airports following equipment outage, FAA says
item.description: Flights at Newark Liberty International, John F. Kennedy International and LaGuardia airports were delayed due to an equipment outage, the FAA says.

item.title: Man shot by ICE being detained with bullet still in his back, lawyer says
item.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, the 28-year-old Venezuelan national shot by an ICE officer on Sunday, said in a phone call on Monday that he's "not doing well."

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Sept. 20)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Extended interview: Andy Beshear
item.description: In this web exclusive, Andy Beshear, the Democratic governor of Kentucky, talks with CBS News' Robert Costa about his new book, "Go and Do Likewise: How We Heal a Broken Country," and about his advice to Democrats on how to win over voters: "Just be real."

item.title: Massive East Coast air travel disruption caused by accidentally cut fiber line, Duffy says
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says an Amtrak crew accidentally cut into a Verizon fiber line in New Jersey on Monday, causing an outage that led to major air travel issues along the East Coast. CBS News' Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's attorney requests investigation into holdout juror
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyers asked a judge to question the holdout juror about his alleged use of a cellphone during deliberations and his truthfulness on a jury questionnaire.

item.title: Iran warns new U.S. assault would see it expand "geography of the war"
item.description: As President Trump touts a looming decision on his next move in the war, Tehran says any "new aggression" would be met with different weapons in new places.

item.title: Lawsuit argues companies made illegal deal on AI slowdown
item.description: A new lawsuit alleges that several leading artificial intelligence companies violated antitrust laws by agreeing to a coordinated slowdown. Renée DiResta, associate research professor at Georgetown University's Massive Data Institute, joins with analysis.

item.title: Paramount Skydance reaches antitrust deal with states over Warner Bros. Discovery purchase
item.description: Paramount's agreement with 12 state attorneys general paves the way for the company to complete its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Man shot by ICE agent in Texas facing deportation
item.description: Protesters are speaking out in Austin, Texas, following another shooting involving a federal immigration officer. CBS News immigration correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: Trump White House justifies press ban by invoking Obama
item.description: The Trump administration on Monday reached back to former President Barack Obama's attempts to limit Fox News coverage of his presidency to justify President Trump's decision to ban CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House grounds. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe has more.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue to restore White House access
item.description: The three news organizations, which were banned from White House grounds by President Trump, are arguing that the ban is unconstitutional.

item.title: Selling early access to Trump Truth Social posts is illegal, ex-prosecutors say
item.description: Trump Media & Technology recently launched a Truth Social API data feed, charging $100,000 for "real-time access to posts from the highest-ranking Truth Social accounts."

item.title: Man shot by ICE agent in Texas still detained with bullet in his back, attorney says
item.description: An investigation is underway in Austin, Texas, after a federal immigration agent shot a man in the torso on Sunday. CBS News homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Equipment outage hits major East Coast airports with delays, cancellations
item.description: An equipment outage in the Northeast has forced ground stops and delays at some of the area's busiest airports. CBS News senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave has the details.

item.title: Converse pulls sneaker ad after critics say it uses racist imagery
item.description: Nike-owned Converse acknowledged that an ad for its Chuck Taylor sneaker is "deeply upsetting."

item.title: How to deal with debt when you've already cut back everywhere
item.description: If cutting expenses isn't enough to manage your debt, these strategies may provide you with more meaningful relief.

item.title: Notable Deaths in 2026
item.description: A look back at the esteemed personalities who've left us this year, who'd touched us with their innovation, creativity and humanity.

item.title: Presidential TV pool suspended after Trump bans CNN
item.description: CNN was set to provide pool coverage on Monday and accompany President Trump on a trip to New York City, but there will not be a network TV pool team traveling with him.

item.title: Man shot by ICE agent in Texas takes questions by phone, says bullet still lodged near his spine
item.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, a Venezuelan DoorDash driver who was shot and wounded by an ICE agent Sunday in Austin, Texas, answered questions from reporters via a phone call Monday at a news conference held by civil rights attorneys and immigration advocates. Garces Perez is now in federal custody and he says he still has a bullet lodged near his spine.

item.title: Advocates call for independent probe after Venezuelan DoorDash driver shot by ICE agent in Texas
item.description: Civil rights attorneys and community leaders spoke Monday after a Venezuelan DoorDash driver was shot and wounded by an ICE agent in Austin, Texas, over the weekend. Following coverage of the news conference, CBS News' Nicole Sganga provided more context on the situation.

item.title: Family tied to suspected Chinese spy gave $4.4M to Newsom, Calif. politicians
item.description: C.C. Yin's family has donated nearly $3 million to state-level California political causes and an additional $1,455,027 to federal campaigns.

item.title: Trump announces "AI Force" and plans to unveil "AI Czar"; Nvidia CEO dismisses AI concerns
item.description: President Trump on Saturday announced he is forming an "AI Force" and vowed not to allow a slowdown of AI development despite several recent warnings from industry insiders about the technology's rapid growth. Meanwhile, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is brushing off apocalyptic concerns about AI. Andrew Pantazi, associate editor of breaking news for Axios, joins CBS News to discuss Trump's plans, then CBS News' Jo Ling Kent and Anthony Salvanto unpack Huang's comments and Americans' feelings on AI.

item.title: Paramount Skydance settles with 12 states over acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta on Monday announced details of a settlement reached between Paramount Skydance and 12 states over the company's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Paramount Skydance is the parent company of CBS News.

item.title: Bill Gates says Trump's AI views point to societal blind spot
item.description: "Most of society is still not aware of how quickly it's moving," Gates said of the latest advances in artificial intelligence.

item.title: JB Pritzker reveals GLP-1 use, pressed on possible presidential run
item.description: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker revealed to "CBS Mornings" that for the last two years he has been using a GLP-1 medication to lose weight.

item.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas
item.description: The lawyer for the man identified him as a 28-year-old Venezuelan national, Wilber Rafael Garces Perez. Officials said he was shot at least once in the torso and was in serious but stable condition.

item.title: Patrick Clancy opens up about grief, his children and moving forward
item.description: In the first interview since his ex-wife's murder trial, Patrick Clancy describes what happened at home before his children were killed and how he handled his grief in the aftermath.

item.title: Democrat Andy Beshear on pursuing "The Great American Reset"
item.description: The two-term Kentucky Governor advises his fellow Democrats to speak like "normal people" and not shy away from progressive politics or religious faith. He discusses his book, "Go and Do Likewise," which teaches how to change minds by winning hearts.

item.title: CBS News poll finds more oppose than favor data centers in their area
item.description: Most Americans expect data centers to negatively impact the environment, local resources, although some see economic benefits
